style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, vivid field green #5CA83F for infographic panels, soft light-green wash #EAF4E2 for spec and how-to screens, real field/garden context for scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin-line circular chips in #5CA83F, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral daylight tone, soft directional key, soft contact shadows on product shots, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh agricultural ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, vivid field green #5CA83F, soft light-green wash #EAF4E2, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm orange accent #F5A623; bright neutral daylight tone with soft directional shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type in charcoal #2D2D2D and #FFFFFF; consistent rounded pill-shaped info labels and thin-line icons in #5CA83F; clean product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product standing upright, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte flat infographic panels and real soil/foliage surfaces in scene shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type, charcoal #2D2D2D for dark-on-light text and #FFFFFF for type on green panels
